APIs.APIs_DESC: This section lists all the APIs of the GPT driver.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_OUT.API_PARAMDESC: Pointer where the version information of this driver is stored.

API.API_DESC: The function provides the version information of the GPT driver.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SYNTAX: void Gpt_Init ( const Gpt_ConfigType * const ConfigPtr )
API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Pointer to a selected configuration structure

API.API_DESC: The function initializes the GPT driver in the context of the core from where the API is invoked. Note: Initialization should be performed in the following sequence: 1. Initialize Gpt driver from the master core. 2. Initialize Gpt driver from all applicable slave cores.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info
API.API_DESC: The function de-initializes the GPT driver in the context of core from where this API is invoked. Note: All slave cores must be de-initialized before the master core.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the GPT channel.
Target time in number of ticks.

API.API_DESC: The function starts the selected timer 'Channel' with a defined target time, 'Value', only if the channel is available in the core from where this API is invoked. Note: The maximum range for the target time, 'Value', depends on the type of the timer channel. If the 'Channel' is: 1. TOM channel, the MaxValue is 0xFFFF (16 Bit). 2. ATOM channel, the MaxValue is 0xFFFFFF (24 Bit).

API_ERROR_HANDLING.ERRTEXT: GPT_E_UNINIT, GPT_E_PARAM_VALUE, GPT_E_PARAM_CHANNEL, GPT_E_BUSY, GPT_E_CORE_CHANNEL_MISMATCH, GPT_E_INVALID_START

API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the GPT channel.

API.API_DESC: The function stops the selected timer 'Channel', only if the channel is available in the core from where this API is invoked.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_RETURN.API_PARAMDESC: Remaining timer value (in number of ticks).

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the GPT channel.

API.API_DESC: The function provides the time elapsed in ticks since the previous timer overflow/start, only if the channel is available in the core from where this API is invoked.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_RETURN.API_PARAMDESC: Remaining timer value (in number of ticks).

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the GPT channel.

API.API_DESC: The function returns the time remaining until the target time is reached, only if the channel is available in the core from where this API is invoked..
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_RETURN.API_PARAMDESC: E_OK: No error has been detected E_NOT_OK: Aborted due to errors

API_OUT.API_PARAMDESC: Pointer to time value destination data in RAM

API.API_DESC: The function delivers the current value of the desired GPT Predef Timer. This function can be invoked from any core.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the GPT channel

API.API_DESC: The function enables reporting of Notification for the GPT channel.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the GPT channel.

API.API_DESC: The function disables the interrupt notification for a channel (relevant in normal mode).
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the GPT channel.

API.API_DESC: The function enables wakeup capability for the GPT Channel.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the GPT channel.

API.API_DESC: The function disables the wakeup interrupt of the channel (relevant in sleep mode only).
API.USER_HINTS: This API has no impact if invoked in Normal Mode.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Information on wakeup source to be checked. The associated GPT channel can be determined from configuration data.

API.API_DESC: The function checks if a wakeup capable GPT channel is the source for a wakeup event and calls the ECU state manager service, EcuM_SetWakeupEvent, in case of a valid GPT channel wakeup event.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: GPT_MODE_NORMAL: Normal operation mode of the GPT driver GPT_MODE_SLEEP: Sleep mode of the GPT driver (wakeup capable).

API.API_DESC: The function sets the mode of the GPT Driver to 'SLEEP' mode or 'NORMAL' mode.
API.USER_HINTS: For Predef timers only the master can start or stop the timers.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_RETURN.API_PARAMDESC: E_OK - Initialization comparison is success E_NOT_OK: In case of - Driver is not initialized for current core - Input config Pointer is Null - Input config pointer is other than the one used for Init - Gpt Driver is in Wrong mode in current core - Any of the channels allocated to the current core is not initialized - If predefined timer is not initialized when current core is master core

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Pointer to a selected configuration structure

API.API_DESC: The function verifies the initialization of the GPT driver in context to the core from where the API is invoked. Note: Init check should be performed in the following sequence: 1. Call Gpt_Init from a core (master/salve core). 2. Call Gpt_InitCheck from the same core. Note: The function can run concurrently across cores.
API.API_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Major version number of AUTOSAR specification on which the appropriate implementation is based on.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Minor version number of AUTOSAR specification on which the appropriate implementation is based on.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Patch level version number of AUTOSAR specification on which the appropriate implementation is based on.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Module ID of this module from Module List
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Aurix derivative used for the implementation Note: Default value will be selected based on the target device to ensure the relevance.
PARAMETER.PARAM_DEFAULT_VALUE: _TRICORE_TC3xx (xx will be replaced as per target device. Ex: For TC399 xx will be 99)
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Major version number of the vendor specific implementation of the module. The numbering is vendor specific.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Minor version number of AUTOSAR specification on which the appropriate implementation is based on.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Patch level version number of the vendor specific implementation of the module. The numbering is vendor specific.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: This parameter provides the Vendor Id
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

CONTAINER.CONTAINER_DESC: This container contains the configuration elements for configuring GPT channel of GPT12 timer hardware and the input clock divider selection for the respective timer. For One-shot mode, the multiplicity is 1..1. For Continuous mode the multiplicity is 1..2

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: This parameter decides the clock divider value for GPT12 timer. The value of the parameter cannot be changed across variants since the dependent parameter, Gpt12TimerUsed refers to pre-compile parameter. Default value is zero because the default value of the corresponding register bits are zero.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: This parameter is defined by IFX. It is the reference to GPT12 timer used by GPT Driver. Note: Referred timer channel in MCU should have timer usage as GPT_TIMER_USED_BY_GPT_DRIVER. The value of the parameter cannot be changed across variants since the referred value McuGpt12ModuleAllocationConf is a pre-compile parameter. Since the name of the dependent container is user configurable, the default value is kept as NULL
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

CONTAINER.CONTAINER_DESC: This container contains the configuration elements for configuring TOM/ATOM channel of GTM timer hardware and the input clock selection for the respective timer. For Continuous mode and One-shot mode, the multiplicity is 1..1. For Predef timers, the multiplicity is 2..3. This container is not configurable for devices with no GTM.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
This parameter decides the clock source for TOM/ATOM timer.
Default value: GTM_FIXED_CLOCK_0 selected because TOM channels will run with fixed clock. The value of the parameter cannot be changed across variants since the dependent parameter, GtmTimerUsed refers to pre-compile parameter. This parameter is not configurable for devices with no GTM IP.
PARAMETER.PARAM_RANGE:
GTM_CONFIGURABLE_CLOCK_X: Configurable Clock X is selected for ATOM module, where X = 0 to 7
GTM_FIXED_CLOCK_0: Fixed Clock 0 is selected for TOM module. GTM_FIXED_CLOCK_1: Fixed Clock 1 is selected for TOM module.
GTM_FIXED_CLOCK_2: Fixed Clock 2 is selected for TOM module. GTM_FIXED_CLOCK_3: Fixed Clock 3 is selected for TOM module. GTM_FIXED_CLOCK_4: Fixed Clock 4 is selected for TOM module.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: This parameter is defined by IFX. It is the reference to GTM timer channel (TOM/ATOM) used by GPT Driver. Note: Referred timer channel in MCU should have TomChannelUsage/ AtomChannelUsage as GTM_TOM_CHANNEL_USED_BY_GPT / GTM_ATOM_CHANNEL_USED_BY_GPT. Since the name of the dependent container is user configurable, the default value is kept as NULL. The value of the parameter cannot be changed across variants since the referred parameters, McuGtmTomChannelAllocationConf and McuGtmAtomChannelAllocationConf are pre-compile parameters. This parameter is not configurable for devices with no GTM IP.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

CONTAINER.CONTAINER_DESC: Configuration of the GPT (General Purpose Timer) driver
This container is the base of a Configuration Set which contains the configured GPT channels. This way, different configuration sets can be defined for the post-build process.
Configuration of an individual GPT channel

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
Specifies the hardware used for the GPT channel(GPT12 or GTM).
The value of the parameter cannot be changed across variants since the dependent parameters Gpt12TimerUsed and GtmTimerUsed refer to pre-compile parameters.
By default this will contain GPT12 since it is present across all TC3xx controller variants.
PARAMETER.PARAM_RANGE: GPT12: The GPT channel will be realized using GPT12 hardware. GTM: The GPT channel will be realized using GTM(ATOM/TOM) hardware.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Reference to the GptClockReferencePoint from which the clock for the channel is derived.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Maps an Gpt channel to zero or multiple ECUC partitions to limit the access to this channel. The ECUC partitions referenced are a subset of the ECUC partitions where the Gpt driver is mapped to. Note: Parameter support is added only for AUTOSAR schema compliance, this parameter is not used in code generation logic, hence this parameter is made editable false.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Channel Id of the GPT channel. This value will be assigned to the symbolic name derived from the GptChannelConfiguration container short name. The value should be unique and continuous starting from 0. Note: Default value is set to minimum value.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
Specifies the behavior of the timer channel after the target time is reached.
By default this will refer to continues mode to ensure that the timer is running all the times.
PARAMETER.PARAM_RANGE: GPT_CH_MODE_CONTINUOUS: After reaching the target time, the timer continues running with the value "zero" again. GPT_CH_MODE_ONESHOT: After reaching the target time, the timer stops automatically (timer expired).
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
Specifies the tick frequency of the timer channel in Hz. This parameter value shall hold the intended channel tick frequency configured for GPT channel through MCU clock setting.
Note: The GptChannelTickFrequency parameter is not used internally by the IFX GPT driver to generate code, but is rather made available to higher-level modules that may require access to this information.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
This parameter value shall hold the intended channel tick value configured for GPT channel through MCU clock setting.
Note: The GptChannelTickValueMax parameter is not used internally by the IFX GPT driver to generate code, but is rather made available to higher-level modules that may require access to this information.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Enables wakeup capability of MCU for a channel. Note: Not applicable if the channel is configured for Predef Timer. The optional features are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: The GptNotification is used by the GPT driver to invoke the user-defined function for notification purposes(for non-wakeup notification). The parameter can be a name or the address(numeric value) of the notification function. Note: The GPT driver does not validate the configured function name or address for correctness and the responsibility falls on the user. Note: Notification is not applicable if the channel is configured for Predef Timer.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Specifies the usage of the timer channel as a predefined timer or normal GPT timer. By default it will be normal channel because a normal channel can be used for all possible configurations (free running/ OSM etc). For devices where GTM IP is not available, only GPT_TIMER_CHANNEL_NORMAL option is available and the Predef timer support is disabled.
PARAMETER.PARAM_RANGE: GPT_PREDEF_TIMERCH_100US_32BIT: Channel is selected as Gpt Predef Timer with tick duration 100 us and range 32bit. GPT_PREDEF_TIMERCH_1US_16BIT: Channel is selected as Gpt Predef Timer with tick duration 1 us and range 16 bit. GPT_PREDEF_TIMERCH_1US_16_24BIT: Channel is selected as Gpt Predef Timer with tick duration 1 us and range 24bit. GPT_PREDEF_TIMERCH_1US_16_24_32BIT: Channel selected as Gpt Predef Timer with tick duration 1 us and range 32bit. GPT_TIMER_CHANNEL_NORMAL: Channel is selected as normal Gpt timer
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

CONTAINER.CONTAINER_DESC: This container contains a parameter, which represents a reference to a container of the type McuClockReferencePoint (defined in module MCU). A container is needed to support multiple clock references (hardware dependent). Since the name of the dependent container is user configurable, the default value is kept as NULL

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Reference to a container of the type McuClockReferencePoint, to select an input clock. This parameter is kept non-editable since the MCU clock reference is provided by another parameter. This parameter is kept to maintain compatibility with Autosar.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
Reference to a container of the type McuClockReferencePointConfig, to select an input clock.
The configuration editor for the GPT driver can support the integrator by only allowing a selection of those clock reference points that can be connected physically to the GPT hardware peripheral. The desired frequency (desired by the GPT driver) has to be the same as the selected and provided frequency of the MCU configuration. This has to be checked automatically.
Since the name of the dependent container is user configurable, the default value is kept as NULL
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

CONTAINER.CONTAINER_DESC: This container contains all configuration switches for configuring optional API services of the GPT driver.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Adds/removes the service Gpt_DeInit() from the code. Note: The optional APIs are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Adds/removes the services Gpt_EnableNotification() and Gpt_DisableNotification from the code. Note: The optional APIs are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Adds/removes the service Gpt_InitCheck() from the code. Note: The detection of safety related errors is enable by default to ensure that safety issues are addressed during the product lifecycle.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Adds/removes the service Gpt_GetTimeElapsed() from the code. Note: The optional APIs are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Adds/removes the service Gpt_GetTimeRemaining() from the code. Note: The optional APIs are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Adds/removes the service Gpt_GetVersionInfo() from the code. Note: The optional APIs are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Adds/removes the services Gpt_SetMode(), Gpt_EnableWakeup(), Gpt_DisableWakeup() and Gpt_CheckWakeup() from the code. Note: The optional APIs are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

CONTAINER.CONTAINER_DESC: This container contains the module-wide configuration (parameters) of the GPT driver

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Maps the GPT driver to zero or multiple ECUC partitions to make the driver API available in the according partition. Note: Parameter support is added only for AUTOSAR schema compliance, this parameter is not used in code generation logic, hence this parameter is made editable false.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Maps the GPT kernel to zero or one ECUC partitions to assign the driver kernel to a certain core. The ECUC partition referenced is a subset of the ECUC partitions where the GPT driver is mapped to. Note: Parameter support is added only for AUTOSAR schema compliance, this parameter is not used in code generation logic, hence this parameter is made editable false.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: This parameter enables or disables the Multi core related default error tracer (Det) detection and reporting. It is applicable only when DETs are enabled. GptMultiCoreErrorDetect shall be set to FALSE if CPU selected is single core.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
Enables/disables the GPT Predef Timer 100us 32bit.
The optional APIs are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size. This parameter is not configurable for devices with no GTM IP.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
Specifies the grade of enabling the GPT Predef Timers with 1 us tick duration.
The optional APIs are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size. This parameter is not configurable for devices with no GTM IP.
PARAMETER.PARAM_RANGE: GPT_PREDEF_TIMER_1US_16BIT_ENABLED: 16bit timer enabled GPT_PREDEF_TIMER_1US_16_24BIT_ENABLED: 16 and 24bit timers enabled GPT_PREDEF_TIMER_1US_16_24_32BIT_ENABLED: 16, 24 and 32bit timers enabled GPT_PREDEF_TIMER_1US_DISABLED: Specifies that GPT Predef Timers with 1 us tick duration is disabled.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
This parameter enables/disables reading the channel from the cores apart from the core for which the channel has been allocated. This applies to the APIs Gpt_GetTimeElapsed and Gpt_GetTimeRemaining only.
If GptReadfromAllCores is TRUE, it allows the GPT normal channels to be read from all cores. If GptReadfromAllCores is FALSE, it allows the GPT normal channels to be read only from the core for which the GPT channels are configured.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
Enables/Disables wakeup source reporting.
The optional features are disabled by default to minimize the executable code size.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Enables or disables the Runtime Error detection and reporting. If safety is enabled(by setting the parameter GptSafetyEnable to true), GptRunTimeErrorDetect shall be set to true. true: enabled (ON). false: disabled (OFF).
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.4.0 and R24-11.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: Switch to enable/disable the safety check and reporting. Note: The detection of safety related errors are enabled by default to ensure the safety issues are addressed during the product life cycle.
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

CONTAINER.CONTAINER_DESC: Function pointer to callback function (for wakeup notification).

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC:
In case the wakeup-capability is true this value is transmitted to the ECU State Manager.
Since the name of the dependent container is user configurable, the default value is kept as NULL
PARAMETER.PARAM_AutosarVersion: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

DATATYPES.DATATYPES_DESC: This section list all the data types of the GPT driver.

DATATYPE_RANGE.RANGE_DESC: The range is based on the number of TOM channels, ATOM channels and GPT12 timer channels for the device variant. The maximum number of channels will vary depending on the device variant. 197 is for the superset device variant.

DATATYPE.DATATYPE_DESC: Numeric ID of a GPT channel. Note: Maximum number of channels depends on the device.
DATATYPE.DATATYPE_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

LITERAL.LITERAL_DESC: Normal operation mode of the GPT
Operation for reduced power operation mode. In sleep mode only wakeup capable channels are available.

DATATYPE.DATATYPE_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

DATATYPE.DATATYPE_TYPE: Pointer to a function of type void Function_Name ( void )
DATATYPE.DATATYPE_DESC: Timer Channel notification function pointer type.
DATATYPE.DATATYPE_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

LITERAL.LITERAL_DESC: GPT Predef Timer with tick duration 1µs and range 16bit
GPT Predef Timer with tick duration 1µs and range 24bit
GPT Predef Timer with tick duration 1µs and range 32bit
GPT Predef Timer with tick duration 100µs and range 32bit

DATATYPE.DATATYPE_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

LITERAL.LITERAL_DESC: The elements of the data structure are specific to the micro-controller.

DATATYPE.DATATYPE_DESC: This is the type of the data structure including the configuration set required for initializing the GPT timer unit.
DATATYPE.DATATYPE_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

DATATYPE_RANGE.RANGE_DESC: Maximum supported timer value/setting periodic timer values (in number of ticks).

DATATYPE.DATATYPE_DESC: Type for reading and setting the timer values (in number of ticks).
DATATYPE.DATATYPE_AUTOSAR_VERSION: Applicable for Autosar versions 4.2.2, 4.4.0 and R24-11.

ERROR_HANDLING.ERROR_HANDLING_DESC: This section describes the various errors reported by the GPT driver.

ERROR.ERR_DESC: Error reported when the driver is already initialized for the current core.

ELEMENT.NAME: GPT12: primary hardware peripheral
ELEMENT.DESC:
Hardware functional features The GPT driver uses the GPT12 IP for realizing the continuous timer mode and one-shot timer mode. Implementation of a continuous mode logical channel using GPT1 block needs two timers, core timer T3 and one of the auxiliary timer(T2 or T4). Implementation of a continuous mode logical channel using GPT2 block needs only T6(uses CAPREL register as reload register). Implementation of one-shot mode logical channel needs only one timer from either of GPT1 or GPT2 block. Predef timer is not supported by GPT12 IP. The key hardware functional feature of GPT12 IP used by the GPT driver is:
  • Timer mode
  • Reload functionality
The unsupported features of the GPT12 IP are:
  • Gated Timer Mode
  • Counter mode
  • Incremental Interface Mode
  • Capture functionality
Users of the hardware The GPT12 IP is shared between the GPT and the ICU drivers. The MCU driver provides an API to initialize the GPT12 control registers. The GPT driver uses this API to initialize the GPT12 control registers. Updates to channel-specific SFRs are performed by the GPT driver. Since the GPT12 timer/s used by GPT driver are exclusively reserved for the GPT channels, access to the channel-specific SFRs from other drivers or user software is not allowed. Hardware diagnostic features Not applicable. Hardware events The GPT driver uses the following hardware event from the GPT12 IP:
  • Timer counter underflow event to provide notification when target time is elapsed.

ELEMENT.NAME: GTM: primary hardware peripheral
ELEMENT.DESC:
Hardware functional features The GPT driver uses the GTM IP for realizing the continuous timer mode, one-shot timer mode and predef timers. Continuous and one-shot mode logical channels need only one timer channel from TOM/ATOM slice. Predef timers use only the TOM slice of the GTM IP because TOM is 16-bit timer and derivation of 16-, 24- and 32-bits are easier compared to ATOM which is 24 bit. If the fGTM is configured such that, the required frequency for the particular timer(1MHz for 1us predef timer and 10KHz for 100us predef timer) can be directly derived , then the 16-bit predef timer needs only one TOM channel(x) and the 24- or 32- bits predef timers need two TOM channels(x and x+1) respectively. The TRIGOUT feature of the hardware where a previous TOM channel triggers the next TOM channel on a compare match event, is used in case of 24-/32-bits timer. If the fGTM is configured such that, the required frequency cannot be directly derived, then an extra channel(x-1, apart from the normal number of channels needed) is used as a prescalar to derive the required tick frequency for the predef timer. Here also the TRIGOUT feature of the hardware is used to achieve the 1us/100us tick frequency. For example, if both 24-/32-bit 1us and 100us predef timers are configured and the fGTM is configured such that the required frequency for the particular timer cannot be directly derived, then a total of six TOM channels are required. The key hardware functional features of GTM-TOM/ATOM IP used by the GPT driver are:
  • Continuous counting up mode
  • One-shot counting up mode
  • Predefine timers feature implemented using TOM slices
The unsupported features of the GTM-TOM/ATOM IP are:
  • Duty cycle, period and clock frequency update mechanisms
  • Continuous counting up-down mode
  • One-shot counting up-down mode
  • Pulse count modulation mode
  • Trigger generation
  • ATOM signal output mode immediate (SOMI)
  • ATOM signal output mode compare (SOMC)
  • ATOM signal output mode serial (SOMS)
  • ATOM signal output mode buffered compare (SOMB)
  • ATOM Signal Output Mode PWM (SOMP)
Users of the hardware The GTM-TOM/ATOM IP is shared by multiple drivers such as GPT, OCU, PWM, WDG and ADC. The MCU driver provides APIs to program the GTM SFRs. The GPT driver uses these APIs to write the GTM SFRs. Additionally, updates to channel-specific SFRs are performed by the GPT driver. Since these channels are exclusively reserved for the GPT driver, access to the channel-specific SFRs from other drivers or user software is not allowed. Hardware diagnostic features Not applicable. Hardware events The GPT driver uses the following hardware event from the GTM-TOM/ATOM IP:
  • Period match interrupt to provide notification when target time is elapsed.

ELEMENT.NAME: SCU: dependent hardware peripheral
ELEMENT.DESC: Hardware functional features The GPT driver depends upon the SCU IP for the clock. The driver requires the fGTM and fSPB clock signals for functioning. Users of the hardware The SCU IP supplies clock for all the peripherals and the MCU driver is responsible for configuring the clock tree. To avoid conflicts due to simultaneous writes, update to all the ENDINIT protected registers is performed using the MCALLIB APIs. Hardware diagnostic features The SMU alarms configured for the SCU IP are not monitored by the GPT driver. Hardware events Hardware events from the SCU are not used by the GPT driver.

HW_SW_INTERFACE.RESPONSIBILITIES:
The GPT driver is responsible for providing APIs for standard timer functions specified by AUTOSAR. The underlying timer engines are GTM timer channel [TOM/ATOM slice] and GPT12 timers that are available in AURIX2G controllers. The user can configure the driver with multiple channels and the following operations can be performed on each channel:
  • Start / Stop the timer
  • Enable/Disable wakeup functionality
  • Enable / Disable notification
  • One Shot or Continuous mode of operation
  • GPT Predef Timer feature implemented using TOM slices.
Apart from the configurable parameters specified by AUTOSAR, the GPT driver also provides additional parameters to configure the GTM timer slice and GPT12 timers.

EXPORTED_AOUS.DESC: The AoU for the GPT driver are as follows:

AOUS.NAME: Configuration check
AOUS.NOTES: User shall ensure that the generated configuration is correct against the GUI configurations provided by the user.

AOUS.NAME: Disabling the interrupts in critical section
AOUS.NOTES: User shall protect the read sequence of Predef timer with resolution more than 16 bits by disabling the interrupts in the critical section Get1UsPredefTimerValue and Get100UsPredefTimerValue.

AOUS.NAME: Execution sequence for initialization check
AOUS.NOTES: User shall invoke the Gpt_InitCheck API only after invoking the Gpt_Init API, and before invoking any runtime API other than the Gpt_GetVersionInfo API.

AOUS.NAME: Freedom from interference for MCAL data
AOUS.NOTES: User shall provide protection for the MCAL memory and SFRs from the QM software.

AOUS.NAME: Handling of underflow situation for one-shot mode with GPT12
AOUS.NOTES: The Gpt_GetTimeElapsed and Gpt_GetTimeRemaining APIs for channels using GPT12 auxillary timers should not be invoked from interrupts, which have higher priority than the particular GPT12 channel interrupt.

EXPORTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_DESC: Product Cybersecurity claim is on top of functional safety claim. i.e. Integrator should fulfill safety AoUs along with cybersecurity AoUs to get cybersecurity claim.

TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NAME: AoU: Access to shared registers by other drivers shall be trusted
TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NOTES: Other drivers accessing shared registers shall be part of same level of trusted domain. E.g. if GTM or GPT12 channels are allocated to GPT driver in trusted domain then they shall not be accessed from other drivers in untrusted or lower trust domains.

TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NAME: AoU: Gpt instances executed from different trust domains
TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NOTES: Integrator shall also ensure to maintain separation of resources among GPT driver instances in multiple cores using resource allocation, such that the GTM/GPT channels used by trusted cores are not shared with untrusted cores, e.g: If GPT modules in trusted cores uses GTM channels (TOM/ATOM), then GPT modules in untrusted cores shall only use GPT12 channels and vice versa.

TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NAME: AoU: MCAL CooC - code and data to be protected
TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NOTES: The system integrator SHALL ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the MCAL CooC's code and data (volatile and non-volatile).

TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NAME: AoU: MCAL CooC and callee - in the same trust domain
TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NOTES:
The system integrator SHALL ensure that MCAL CooC is executed in the same trust domain as the services used by the MCAL CooC.
Rationale: MCAL is executed in the same context as the callee, hence with the same memory protection settings. Therefore, the callee is assumed to be within the same trust domain.

TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NAME: AoU: Users or callers of Gpt MCAL CooC in the same level of trust domain
TRUSTED_AOUS.TRUSTED_NOTES: The system integrator SHALL ensure that MCAL CooC is executed in the same level of trust domain as its caller.
